name: What kind of preparation is needed before accepting a cash offer or listing with an agent?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before accepting a cash offer or listing with an agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before accepting a cash offer, prepare by understanding your home's fair market value and any urgent repairs needed. For listing with an agent, preparation often involves decluttering, minor repairs, staging, and landscaping to enhance curb appeal. Kelby Contreras can walk you through a personalized checklist, outlining specific steps needed to maximize your outcome whether in Fort Lauderdale or West Palm Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: For cash offers, assess market value; for agent listings, focus on repairs, staging, and curb appeal to attract buyers.
